limitations: Input requires caller-assigned device-scoped entity_id and logged snapshot_id for each app|recent|N row, with snapshots in first-seen time order within each entity. Device attribution, polling, elapsed-realtime conversion, time-reference joins, and snapshot grouping remain upstream; entity_id is a Chronicle input field, not a claimed Device Analyzer CSV column.

Consecutive snapshots with identical rank-and-component lists are dropped separately per entity; different source row IDs do not make a list new. Within retained snapshots, canonical zero-based decimal ranks below the ten-row capacity are emitted from largest source rank to zero. Duplicate ranks and missing or malformed required fields fail closed as typed-boundary safeguards.

The component does not infer launches, remove partially overlapping snapshots, or claim the paper's undisclosed cross-snapshot delta algorithm. Component values remain opaque; Intent flattening, hashing, package/activity normalization, transition construction, matrices, and downstream statistics remain outside this component.

Input is caller-supplied app-launch rows already ordered within each entity and already assigned opaque, entity-local hour and day scope identifiers. Snapshot differencing, launch-time reconstruction, timezone and calendar assignment, hashing, and cohort selection remain upstream.

The paper does not disclose co-occurrence direction or multiplicity, diagonal handling, or probability denominators. Input must therefore supply one explicit matrix_policy_json; repeated nonempty policy cells must agree and any Undisclosed policy fails closed. A successful component run proves only the caller-selected generic configuration, while the exact paper profile remains source-blocked on those choices.

The component emits sparse positive consecutive-transition, same-hour, and same-day occurrence/probability cells plus tied maximum transition targets per source app. It does not implement the paper's power regression, F-Tests, Z-Tests, cross-model comparisons, or reported results.

registry_input.method_value_json: "a later Device Analyzer dictionary describes time|bootup and time|changed reference records, but a study-version link and the paper's exact elapsed-to-wall-clock join are unproved"

limitations: Only mean/min/max and odd-cardinality median of one complete finite named non-GPS basic feature are computed. Caller supplies feature family/name, target_day_id, complete membership/order and coherent units. Empty summaries and even-cardinality median remain unavailable; no NA removal, source window construction, variance, SD, quantiles or inferred even convention. The NEW mean alone is arithmetic_unavailable when the unchanged existing loss detector cannot reliably retain an ordered sum contribution or the nonzero total divides to binary64 zero. Independently computable extrema/odd median remain available; no compensated total/mean is exported and no author numeric convention is inferred.

Caller supplies participant, device, exact source_context_id, clock and coherent units; each row is one independently complete source-qualified membership/operand domain. Identical repeated CSV rows are preserved; conflicting same-context membership/order/clock/unit attribution refuses. No raw collector, calendar/window/eligibility/missingness construction or full parent/model runtime is claimed.

Caller supplies the complete eligible SMS incoming/outgoing pair membership, exact same-peer last-incoming qualification and event order, including any equal-time ordering. Typed roles, shared supplied clock, identity reuse, nonnegative exact elapsed ns and inclusive <=1h latency are validated; no raw matcher, floor-seconds or response-rate/multi-reply constructor is executed. Existing i128 subtraction is reused; validated ns <=3.6e12 are exact binary64 integers for the guarded odd median, formatted to exact decimal seconds. Empty/even median remains unavailable.

Caller supplies participant, device, exact source_context_id, clock and coherent units; each row is one independently complete source-qualified membership/operand domain. Identical repeated CSV rows are preserved; conflicting same-context membership/order/clock/unit attribution refuses. No raw collector, calendar/window/eligibility/missingness construction or full parent/model runtime is claimed.

Retained-hit mode consumes complete caller-qualified RSSI>=0 hit membership and computes distinct literal IDs, maximum per-ID hit frequency (not a winning ID), and distinct IDs/hits ratio. Complete empty membership has known distinct0/hits0, but maximum/zero-denominator ratio are unavailable. Existing RSSI filter is separate; no filter or contact alias inference is claimed.

limitations: CognitiveRhythms primary physicalp7–8. Complete qualified unlock-marked phone-session inventory supplies hourly session count, mean full-session seconds, strict<30 class (30 is not short), and short COUNT without an unknown normalization denominator. Separate complete hourly duration-contribution inventory supplies hourly total; count/mean and duration-sum domains are not forced equal or clipped by this stage. Required3600-second source hour is explicitly qualified, not an invented wall-clock/DST/calendar constructor. Historical screen/keyguard endpoints/tails/hour allocation and reduced/full-model equivalence remain unknown; no PVT/model/survey scoring.

Original lexical CSV cells/JSON, source row IDs, explicit device/stream/participant/scope, list order and extra columns survive one-to-one. Duplicate recognized JSON keys are refused by ordinary typed serde fields before collapse; distinct complete-inventory IDs and zero-based source order where specified are caller qualifications. Local known identity facts are checked across repeated declarations without imputing any row's missing calculation input. A device in one input requires stable participant/source stream and declared coordinate unit/positive precision metadata; precision is not quantization, rounding or epoch-modulo alignment. Explicit[] is complete empty; empty inventory cell/unknown scalar remains unavailable. Known coherent clock/endpoints use unchanged i64-to-i128 elapsed helper; binary64 ordered sum/projection/mean/count ratio is Chronicle's disclosed typed numeric boundary, not historical runtime parity. Full source profile, raw constructors, cohorts, models and app/WASM proof remain unclaimed.

Input is a normalized supplied trial table using the released callable defaults user_id, session, and response_time, with nonmissing opaque string identities and numeric latency in milliseconds. It is not a recovered study export. The caller must supply actual PVT trial latency and assessment-session/person attribution; ordinary Android UsageEvents cannot invent stimulus or response events.

Positive trials are retained before each person/session median; duplicates are preserved. NaN is a comparison-failing missing value, not zero; NaN and negative infinity are dropped, while positive infinity enters the source aggregation. Session MRT values are recursively retained only strictly inside the current participant mean plus/minus 2.5 sample SD. Sample SD divides by n-1 as an explicit pandas compatibility convention; the publication runtime/dependencies are not pinned. Singleton and equal-score participants produce no retained rows; a table with no positive trials fails explicitly, matching the released wrapper's failure rather than synthesizing zeros.

The baseline MMRT is the mean of retained session MRT values and RRT percent is 100*(MMRT-MRT)/MMRT. Infinite MRT causes undefined SD/bounds and strict comparisons drop all sessions for that participant; IEEE-754 arithmetic propagation is preserved rather than imposing a generic finite-result guard. Output is ordered by opaque string user/session keys. This source-semantic hand-fixture binding does not claim historical Python runtime, dtype, or arbitrary coercion parity. PVT-Touch collection, before-stimulus false-start attribution, questionnaires, original cohorts, model training, and the full profile remain outside this component.

limitations: Each row supplies the complete caller-qualified pre-sample candidate windows for one participant, source session and sample context. Every candidate carries exact window/app identities and a finite nonnegative binary64 duration in an explicitly matching caller-supplied unit. The paper's unit, clipping, app-name/package resolution and exact collector/window behavior are undisclosed; this component neither infers nor converts them.

Existing finite scalar extrema computes the greatest duration. Exactly one candidate with that maximum yields its window/app. Equal maxima remain source_undefined_tied_argmax, even if apps coincide: no epsilon, first/last/lexical tie-break, per-app sum or candidate aggregation. The known maximum scalar remains available independently; an explicit empty candidate list has no maximum and emits source_undefined_no_windows rather than zero filling.

Duplicate candidate window identities, missing/null/malformed candidates, mismatched units and conflicting supplied data within the same participant/session/sample context fail. Repeated input rows remain; the same physical window may have different qualified durations in distinct sample contexts. IDs must be unambiguous across caller device/partition boundaries; qualification is a supplied declaration, not collector proof. No window/session construction, ongoing-window clipping, calendar/time-bin/category mapping, questionnaire or model execution is owned; full profile remains blocked.

limitations: Input is a caller-supplied transition with literal Table 2 From and To labels: onbike, running, walking, working, still. Lookup direction is row From/column To; printed mean and SD are retained rather than recomputed survey scores.

Only the printed mean strictly greater than 5 qualifies. Walking to running has mean 5 and does not qualify; reverse running to walking has mean 8.2 and qualifies. A blank diagonal remains unreported-diagonal with blank mean/SD/breakpoint, not zero or a negative detector decision.

No ActivityRecognition API/prose-label translation, GPS or sensor feature extraction, transition/state construction, J48 classification, detector freshness/fusion, delivery scheduling, questionnaires or full-paper execution is implemented.

Source-only bounded component and standalone derived CSV/receipt/export, not kernel input or full-profile execution. ClearAll filter_active/Python JSON truth, cardinality/set accumulation, category occurrence count, integer denominator sum, count ratios, finite extrema, ordered scalar sum and existing median/group mean are shared owners, not new algorithms. Repeated occurrences retain multiplicity; no participant weighting, complete-hour/category grid, clipping, availability or category/calendar construction. Input is a caller-complete supplied T inventory with exactly one window manifest and typed eligible session duration_seconds, lexical used-app observations and qualified switch occurrences. Session durations are finite nonnegative seconds. T anchor/endpoint, raw unlock session closer, censoring, partial-session allocation, category membership and switch construction are not inferred.

The unchanged prepared mean gives mean seconds per eligible session; unchanged distinct-member and occurrence-count bodies give lexical distinct app cardinality and every qualified switch occurrence. Repeated app observations do not increase diversity, but switch observations are never deduplicated by app. No mapping of duration/diversity/switches into a foreground count is made.

A declared empty complete inventory computes counts0; empty-session mean emits empty/source_undefined/empty_session_mean_not_disclosed. Arithmetic-unavailable means do not suppress counts or other groups. Missing manifests or malformed/nonfinite input fail closed, without dropping records or imputation.

Only blank validation applies; conflicting scoped units and duplicate source identity/order fail closed. Groups retain first-seen order and arithmetic follows explicit numeric sample/lag ordering; there is no resampling, source unit parser or raw chronology reconstruction.

Missing/nonfinite or unqualified source inventories fail closed without removal/imputation. Existing ordered mean nonfinite arithmetic and detected division underflow emit per-result empty/arithmetic_unavailable while other supplied groups/statistics remain computable. Output-unit relations are explicit input_unit for scalar means/calibration, seconds_per_session, exact count relations or Boolean as appropriate; caller unit labels are not mislabeled as all output units.

Full parent remains blocked. Only these named prepared reductions and their exact source owners are bound, not unknown acquisition/window/schema/serializer/model policies, stressor/questionnaire scoring, GPS or whole-study replication.

limitations: Owns both supplied-pair formulas: content_arrival_at_client to notification_posting is delivery_delay; notification_posting to notification_user_click is response_latency. The source's one-hour scheduling fallback is not a hard maximum or a response-latency censor.

Input is an explicit caller-resolved pair, not a raw collector schema: signed integer-nanosecond endpoints carry exact participant, notification, event, event-kind and clock identities. Paired participant/notification/clock IDs must match; repeated event identity must retain the same attribution, kind, clock and timestamp. Upstream identity construction and physical clock synchronization are not recovered.

Outputs preserve input order, duplicates and signed end-minus-start differences, with exact nanosecond and decimal-second values. No truncation, rounding, clamp, timeout, first-attendance selection, ordering, tie repair or undocumented eligibility rule is imposed. Negative arithmetic results do not assert admission to the study's measured population; absent endpoints fail closed instead of becoming zero.

Only the named elapsed calculation is implemented. Source-unknown callback pairing, response selection, unobserved notifications, raw collection, context features, outcome models and full-paper execution remain outside this component.

limitations: Owns supplied formulas from accepted primary manuscript p3 Figure2/prose: ST=assumed_seen-arrival, DT=source_action-assumed_seen, total=source_action-arrival=ST+DT. Source action_kind must be notification_bar_click, corresponding_app_launch or swipe_dismiss; generic removal is not substituted because its relation to reaction is source-unknown.

Input_stage=caller-resolved-arrival-seen-action. Caller-resolved rows supply event IDs and signed i64 nanosecond anchors under one participant-scoped common clock. Each participant/event ID must retain clock/time/role attribution. Physical arrival and source action IDs have fixed notification attribution and cannot alias each other or the phone-unlock role. A locked-row assumed-seen ID explicitly denotes one supplied phone unlock and may serve multiple notifications at the same clock/time. This input has no independent device field; participant/event/clock scopes must already be device-qualified upstream. No physical synchronization, unlock search, corresponding-app matching, episode selection, timeout or missing-action default is inferred.

arrival_unlock_state is locked or already_unlocked_or_in_use. The latter requires the supplied assumed-seen timestamp to equal arrival and yields ST=0, an assumption not observed gaze. Its supplied seen ID may alias this notification's arrival ID; a distinct supplied ID denotes its notification-attributed arrival-time seen proxy, not a physical unlock. Action IDs cannot alias either proxy form. No item-local IDs are constructed. Missing anchors/state fail closed; removed-before-unlock and first-attendance handling remain unresolved upstream.

Reuses unchanged i128 endpoint subtraction and signed exact decimal-seconds formatting. Preserves duplicate rows, input order, signed/fractional/zero/full-range differences with no clamp or rounding; negative arithmetic does not assert study-population admission. The separate 3131901 source's two-hour cutoff is NOT applied.

The p4 arrival/seen/removal dataset fields do not prove generic removal equals the p3 action-ended DT. Source analysis-specific already-engaged exclusions, questionnaire cooldowns, censoring, inferred seen construction, raw collectors and full-profile execution remain unimplemented. This retained accepted manuscript has template DOI placeholders; bibliographic identity was separately verified, not represented as the definitive ACM version.

Input is an explicit caller-resolved pair, not a raw collector schema: signed integer-nanosecond endpoints carry exact participant, notification, event, event-kind and clock identities. Paired participant/notification/clock IDs must match; repeated event identity must retain the same attribution, kind, clock and timestamp. Upstream identity construction and physical clock synchronization are not recovered.

Outputs preserve input order, duplicates and signed end-minus-start differences, with exact nanosecond and decimal-second values. No truncation, rounding, clamp, timeout, first-attendance selection, ordering, tie repair or undocumented eligibility rule is imposed. Negative arithmetic results do not assert admission to the study's measured population; absent endpoints fail closed instead of becoming zero.

Only the named elapsed calculation is implemented. Source-unknown callback pairing, response selection, unobserved notifications, raw collection, context features, outcome models and full-paper execution remain outside this component.

IDs are literal and untrimmed; every positive anchor/member requires common participant/device/source-stream/source-sequence ownership. Source events/items/actions remain distinct; known event/item/app/terminal facts cannot contradict. Supplied row order, original columns/extras and whole-row duplicates are preserved; pending-set IDs are explicitly unique normalized set members, not deduplicated raw occurrences.

Typed anchor JSON declares event_id, role, clock_id, time_unit, precision and signed i64 timestamp. Common ns/us/ms/s integer coordinates use unchanged widened subtraction and exact signed decimal seconds formatting. Missing/null or incompatible clocks/units/timestamps/precision yield unavailable non-Sensors timing, never zero; known reversed qualified spans reject. Precision is positive metadata, never an epoch alignment, modulo, quantization, constant-precision or rounding gate. Null is unknown, not an empty identity.

Complete caller-qualified shown-pending drawer membership is distinct from all pending notifications. Drawer positive members require shown_in_drawer=true. App attribution uses exact literal app equality. Viewed time minus arrival time is a proxy only, never evidence of content reading, notification click, response or dismissal. Other-pending-count domain, raw item keys, first-view matching and censoring are not inferred.

limitations: Owns click_time only for supplied notification_presentation to observed notification_drawer_click pairs. App launch, swipe, removal, inferred attention and never-clicked cases cannot substitute; source outlier/category analysis remains separate.

Input is an explicit caller-resolved pair, not a raw collector schema: signed integer-nanosecond endpoints carry exact participant, notification, event, event-kind and clock identities. Paired participant/notification/clock IDs must match; repeated event identity must retain the same attribution, kind, clock and timestamp. Upstream identity construction and physical clock synchronization are not recovered.

Outputs preserve input order, duplicates and signed end-minus-start differences, with exact nanosecond and decimal-second values. No truncation, rounding, clamp, timeout, first-attendance selection, ordering, tie repair or undocumented eligibility rule is imposed. Negative arithmetic results do not assert admission to the study's measured population; absent endpoints fail closed instead of becoming zero.

Only the named elapsed calculation is implemented. Source-unknown callback pairing, response selection, unobserved notifications, raw collection, context features, outcome models and full-paper execution remain outside this component.

Use-state must be supplied as in_use or not_in_use and be consistent for each raw lexical (participant_id, interruption_id) identity; stage=pre_interruption and outcome=none make the pre-trigger stage separate from the later Table2 measures. No decision readings or response labels are injected into pre-trigger predictors.

Lexical participant/entity/window/stream/units are retained without trimming, normalization or conversion. Only blank validation applies; conflicting scoped units and duplicate source identity/order fail closed. Groups retain first-seen order and arithmetic follows explicit numeric sample/lag ordering; there is no resampling, source unit parser or raw chronology reconstruction.

Missing/nonfinite or unqualified source inventories fail closed without removal/imputation. Existing ordered mean nonfinite arithmetic and detected division underflow emit per-result empty/arithmetic_unavailable while other supplied groups/statistics remain computable. Output-unit relations are explicit input_unit for scalar means/calibration, seconds_per_session, exact count relations or Boolean as appropriate; caller unit labels are not mislabeled as all output units.

limitations: Caller supplies complete finite scalar calibration membership for the first two seconds of each call and separately qualified later scalar observations, with calibration_duration_seconds=2. Numeric sample ordering must put all post-calibration observations after the last calibration member. Width, completeness and stages are input qualifications, not recovered timer endpoints, sample cadence or call/window construction.

The existing finite scalar maximum gives the calibration reference; threshold=1.5*maximum and later value>threshold emits a Boolean, with equality false and no tolerance. Signed finite caller scalars are preserved; no magnitude, gravity filtering or unit interpretation is invented. Empty calibration fails closed; a supplied call without later observations emits no invented comparison.

A nonfinite threshold emits empty value/arithmetic_unavailable and unavailable comparison rows while its finite maximum and independent calls remain computable. Original calibration/action owners are unbound: no mute, intervention state, availability predictor, ringer control, restoration or author application/version parity is claimed.

Lexical participant/entity/window/stream/units are retained without trimming, normalization or conversion. Only blank validation applies; conflicting scoped units and duplicate source identity/order fail closed. Groups retain first-seen order and arithmetic follows explicit numeric sample/lag ordering; there is no resampling, source unit parser or raw chronology reconstruction.

Missing/nonfinite or unqualified source inventories fail closed without removal/imputation. Existing ordered mean nonfinite arithmetic and detected division underflow emit per-result empty/arithmetic_unavailable while other supplied groups/statistics remain computable. Output-unit relations are explicit input_unit for scalar means/calibration, seconds_per_session, exact count relations or Boolean as appropriate; caller unit labels are not mislabeled as all output units.

Full parent remains blocked. Only these named prepared reductions and their exact source owners are bound, not unknown acquisition/window/schema/serializer/model policies, stressor/questionnaire scoring, GPS or whole-study replication.

limitations: Constructed normalized typed input boundary, not recovered raw export or collector. IDs are literal and untrimmed; every positive anchor/member requires common participant/device/source-stream/source-sequence ownership. Source events/items/actions remain distinct; known event/item/app/terminal facts cannot contradict. Supplied row order, original columns/extras and whole-row duplicates are preserved; pending-set IDs are explicitly unique normalized set members, not deduplicated raw occurrences.

Typed anchor JSON declares event_id, role, clock_id, time_unit, precision and signed i64 timestamp. Common ns/us/ms/s integer coordinates use unchanged widened subtraction and exact signed decimal seconds formatting. Missing/null or incompatible clocks/units/timestamps/precision yield unavailable non-Sensors timing, never zero; known reversed qualified spans reject. Precision is positive metadata, never an epoch alignment, modulo, quantization, constant-precision or rounding gate. Null is unknown, not an empty identity.

Boehmer lab TN is first call notification to conversation start including postponement. Field interruptive-call latency separately ends at accepted, declined or stopped ringing. Supplied measure and roles must match; repeated postpone events are not new calls. TOT1 conflicting endpoints, TNV visibility summation, trial means and raw call constructor remain unclaimed.

Full parent profile remains blocked. No classifiers, questionnaire scoring, prediction models, new source admission, raw queue/session framework, ordinary UsageEvents invention or original cohort reconstruction is claimed.
Input contains caller-qualified call-level counts for one explicitly named interrupted app and call scope; repeated postpone actions on one call are not separate postponed calls.
The component emits the supplied numerator, denominator and fraction. Numerator greater than denominator, missing counts, zero denominator and overflow fail closed.
Raw call identity/action linkage, app attribution, cohort filtering, clocks, windows and media/communication category comparison remain upstream or downstream and are not executed.
Input supplies exactly twenty unique trial values in seconds for each caller-resolved participant-condition-time-measure group; different supplied groups are reduced independently.
The component computes arithmetic mean only; timestamp subtraction, unit conversion, trial matching, questionnaires, ANOVA and the reported720-point cohort inventory are not implemented.
Missing, non-finite, negative, duplicate-trial and non-twenty-trial groups fail closed as typed-boundary safeguards; no original study rows or author runtime are claimed.

Sixteen required Chronicle CSV fields supply source-row/participant/device/package-session/feature-occurrence identity, agreeing package names, each clock, signed Long millisecond packageStart/startTime/endTime, time_unit=ms, caller-resolved-later-release stage and exact commit. Milliseconds are source-compatible with retained System.currentTimeMillis callers; no clock parser, normalizer, raw pairing, epoch conversion or timezone is added.

The three literal operations are endTime-startTime, startTime-packageStart and endTime-packageStart. Existing signed i128 subtraction is explicitly truncated to signed i64 to reproduce Kotlin Long wrapping before decimal formatting; full-range negatives, zero and values above binary64 precision are retained without float conversion or duration guard.

Every input occurrence, lexical field, extra column and source order remains unchanged. Each difference independently emits local unavailable diagnostics when one of its own anchors/clocks is missing or clock IDs disagree; unrelated available differences are retained. These diagnostics are Chronicle transport behavior, not a recovered source missing-value/admission policy. Invalid nonempty coordinates, wrong package/unit/release/role or supplied computed-output fields fail closed.

Only supplied coordinates are computed. Accessibility predicates, transition/end assignment, undefined-feature carry-forward, app sessions, labels, feature taxonomy, regret responses, classifier/models, original toRow JSON serialization and deployed-study reproduction are not claimed. Header-only input has valid header-only output; hand math does not execute author code; full-profile execution remains blocked.

limitations: Constructed normalized typed input boundary, not recovered raw export or collector. IDs are literal and untrimmed; every positive anchor/member requires common participant/device/source-stream/source-sequence ownership. Source events/items/actions remain distinct; known event/item/app/terminal facts cannot contradict. Supplied row order, original columns/extras and whole-row duplicates are preserved; pending-set IDs are explicitly unique normalized set members, not deduplicated raw occurrences.

Typed anchor JSON declares event_id, role, clock_id, time_unit, precision and signed i64 timestamp. Common ns/us/ms/s integer coordinates use unchanged widened subtraction and exact signed decimal seconds formatting. Missing/null or incompatible clocks/units/timestamps/precision yield unavailable non-Sensors timing, never zero; known reversed qualified spans reject. Precision is positive metadata, never an epoch alignment, modulo, quantization, constant-precision or rounding gate. Null is unknown, not an empty identity.

Deferral is initial notification posting to caller-resolved FINAL re-triggering, including repeated snoozes. Intermediate re-triggers, snooze actions, selected durations, scheduling and raw copy/chain matching are not substituted or constructed.

Full parent profile remains blocked. No classifiers, questionnaire scoring, prediction models, new source admission, raw queue/session framework, ordinary UsageEvents invention or original cohort reconstruction is claimed.

limitations: Only complete caller-qualified source-day screen-on/off sessions on one supplied device/clock are counted, and exact endpoint durations are summed into screen occupancy seconds and hours. Endpoints must be ordered, identities distinct and intervals already disjoint; overlap refuses rather than clips/unions. Explicit empty inventory is0. App episode sums, sessionApp/NoEvent/WithApp aliases, raw source-day/cross-midnight/censor/missingness definitions, collector and problematic-use scoring/model remain outside.

The ordinary adapter consumes a caller-qualified prepared reduction domain identified by participant, device, source_context_id, clock and coherent value units. Each context represents one target/stream, membership/channel or source sample window; repeated identical CSV rows are preserved, contradictory identity/membership/order/clock/unit attribution refuses. These typed prepared calculations do not prove raw collector execution, complete parent-method/model execution, original participant recovery or browser deployment.

Counts sessions with an explicitly supplied complete empty app inventory in one caller-qualified source day and returns each no-app session's supplied endpoint duration. Requires complete per-session app membership, distinct sessions/endpoints and ordered disjoint screen intervals. Missing/null app inventories refuse; known empty day is zero. App identities are lexical, and a nonempty inventory always excludes the session from no-app. No raw app detector, latest-foreground test, incoming-event alias, threshold, pairing, day/calendar assignment, censoring or unobserved-day synthesis is inferred.

Source: Shin DOI10.1145/2493432.2493443, Table1/session usage physical PDFp4-5 pp338-339 lines267-278,307-314 and Table2 minutes. Endpoint elapsed nanoseconds are exact i128 decimal text; seconds/minutes use the existing Chronicle binary64 duration conversion. Session length inventory is not a source-exact daily mean; no-app is not equated to the conflicting no-incoming-event conclusion. The whole paper profile remains blocked.

Uses the existing prepared CSV carrier and standalone receipt/artifact route. Participant/device/source_context_id/clock/units identify one caller-complete day. Identical repeated carrier occurrences are preserved, not merged or counted as new sessions; contradictory context or row identity refuses. No collector execution, original participant recovery or full outcome model is claimed.

Primary pp338–339, extracted text295–320 SHA25671b83a0d4a0fc7015c9400574fde0423b0f3988e65ed38bb97942444214262b9, discloses repeated same-app collapse throughout a device session, including nonconsecutive repeats, and multiple uses when the same app occurs in different sessions. Only the explicit within-session and across-session atoms are bound; the audit's inferred conceptual raw formula is not promoted.

Caller supplies admitted day markers, explicit screen-session markers and app membership in those sessions. A session belongs to exactly one day within the full lexical participant/device/window scope. Raw screen-state sessionization, app occurrence classification, cross-midnight assignment and day construction are not inferred.

The unchanged distinct-count primitive counts apps per session; daily distinct(session,app) is the exact integer identity sum_s cardinality(apps(s)), not daily global distinct packages. Explicit empty sessions and complete known-zero day inventories can produce0; absent membership, duplicate session/day inventories and day reassignment refuse.

Original lexical identities are retained; output is lexical session counts followed by lexical daily sums, an engineering transport order. No timing thresholds, segmentation, questionnaire, learned outcomes, raw collector implementation or whole study claim.

limitations: Constructed normalized typed input boundary, not recovered raw export or collector. IDs are literal and untrimmed; every positive anchor/member requires common participant/device/source-stream/source-sequence ownership. Source events/items/actions remain distinct; known event/item/app/terminal facts cannot contradict. Supplied row order, original columns/extras and whole-row duplicates are preserved; pending-set IDs are explicitly unique normalized set members, not deduplicated raw occurrences.

Typed anchor JSON declares event_id, role, clock_id, time_unit, precision and signed i64 timestamp. Common ns/us/ms/s integer coordinates use unchanged widened subtraction and exact signed decimal seconds formatting. Missing/null or incompatible clocks/units/timestamps/precision yield unavailable non-Sensors timing, never zero; known reversed qualified spans reject. Precision is positive metadata, never an epoch alignment, modulo, quantization, constant-precision or rounding gate. Null is unknown, not an empty identity.

Only supplied i64 INTEGER-second appearance/removal endpoints are accepted, with matching explicit clock and positive precision metadata. Difference is computed in i128 seconds; rows are actually retained iff IDL>0, removing zero and negative IDL. Missing/ambiguous timing rejects rather than being treated as zero. No subsecond-to-integer conversion, rounding or truncation is invented. Notification update/dedup exclusions, raw appearance/removal matching, removal reason and attention/click inference remain separately unclaimed.

Full parent profile remains blocked. No classifiers, questionnaire scoring, prediction models, new source admission, raw queue/session framework, ordinary UsageEvents invention or original cohort reconstruction is claimed.

limitations: Owns four timestamp formulas from retained primary prose pp183-184 and Figure 1: acceptance=notification delivery to generic notification acceptance click; decision=task-type display to task acceptance; task=task acceptance to response completion including the concluding burden rating; response=acceptance+decision+task.

Each row is one complete response explicitly resolved by the caller, with exact participant/notification/task/common-clock identity, named role event IDs and signed i64 nanosecond timestamps. Named columns assert source roles rather than infer them from raw phone activity. Repeated event identity must retain its notification/task/clock/timestamp attribution; one consistently attributed event may serve notification acceptance and task-type display.

The three phase differences and their sum are i128 arithmetic with exact nanosecond/decimal-second output, preserving order and duplicates. The sum is not the sum of population medians and does not fill an unmeasured gap between notification acceptance and task-type display. No chronology repair, rounding or clamp is imposed; negative results are arithmetic, not population admission.

The source's 30-minute expiry concerns unanswered prompts; it is not applied as a calculated-duration cap. The designed sub-minute tasks do not imply a task-time cap. Deferred/later/reopened/partial-task matching, unspecified raw endpoint fields, completion/burden recognition, missing responses, mobile-activity episode detection and full-study execution remain unimplemented. Missing anchors fail closed instead of becoming zero phases.

Arrival and first inferred attendance endpoints are caller-resolved with notification identity, distinct literal event IDs, exact roles and coherent clock. Subtract only, preserving declared units; no raw attendance inference, first-event selector, cross-device clock mapping or model execution.

Original lexical CSV and JSON cells, IDs, list order and extra columns survive one-to-one. Source-row identity and participant/device/stream/scope ownership are checked; recognized duplicate JSON fields, duplicate complete-inventory IDs and inconsistent known identities are refused. Missing/null/empty cell is absence, never a fact replacement or imputed result. Exact i64 coordinates use existing i128 subtraction with coherent explicit clock and positive precision METADATA (no rounding, modulo, epoch/quantization constraint). Retained known endpoint contradictions are refused without filling original row calculations. Finite binary64 projection/reductions are the disclosed Chronicle typed boundary, not historical numeric/runtime parity. Full raw constructors, original cohort, models, canonical component admission, WASM/app/full-profile execution are unclaimed.

Owns quality.reject_arrival_when_app_foreground only from retained author primary p2 Measures: exclude when literal notification_package == foreground_package_at_arrival; retain literal inequality. Comparison is exact case/whitespace-sensitive and survivors retain input order and duplicates.

Input_stage=caller-resolved-arrival-foreground. Source row, participant, notification and both package strings must be explicitly supplied and nonblank; missing/unknown foreground context fails closed, not as an assumed unequal package or default app.

Raw callback identity, foreground-at-arrival observation/linkage, collector/versioned package schema, messenger allowlist, attendance inference, cross-device inference, features, classifier and population reductions remain outside this narrow predicate. No missing-state policy, package normalization, or global notification de-duplication is added.

limitations: Retained LMU author-hosted Why Did You Stop PDF SHA2561d6962efd1eddeddeeb7c1dc12799dc642ef5e921f42bff8e165eababa277e22, physical p8 §4.4.4, defines net learning-session length in seconds excluding suspending interruption time. This bounded arithmetic reuses the existing ordered scalar sum, then subtracts the supplied disjoint admitted suspending-duration total from supplied gross-session duration. It does not execute an overlap union or recover LAIRA session/interruption endpoints.

Each row explicitly qualifies a complete Android gross learning session and its complete distinct disjoint admitted_suspending duration inventory contained in that session, with matching supplied session references, device/source-stream/app ownership and seconds. These qualifications are supplied, not inferred from records. No timestamps, clock origins, cutoff/equality, endpoint matching, duration construction, collector availability or raw event joins are invented. The source's exact overlap/multiple-interruption union rule remains unknown.

Finite nonnegative binary64 durations and ordered sums are Chronicle's typed arithmetic boundary, not the unreleased study's numeric runtime. Contradictory known session/interruption facts, negative/nonfinite durations and totals exceeding gross are refused. Lexical negative nonzero durations are refused before binary64 underflow across gross, numeric-text and numeric-JSON inputs; genuine lexical zero remains valid. Compatible known gross and distinct inventory-member durations are reconciled across declarations to refuse a proven excess in each supplied inventory's own list order, without imputing any row's missing calculation input. Explicit [] means no admitted suspending interruptions; missing gross/inventory/term stays unavailable in that row and is never filled from other declarations or fabricated as0. Original lexical CSV/JSON, identities, row/list order, repeated rows and extra fields survive. Duplicate interruption IDs within a qualified distinct inventory and duplicate critical entry keys (interruption_id, learning_session_id, kind, duration_seconds) are refused before any last-key value choice, not deduplicated. Raw LAIRA FSM, ESQ/notification classification, GAMLSS and full profile remain unexecuted; author PDF has not been compared with ACM VOR.

limitations: Only source-qualified complete supplied inventories and raw lexical participant/device/scope/clock IDs. No raw session/day/horizon/timezone/calendar/admission/sensor availability or counter delta/reset builder. Explicit complete empty inventories differ from absent/null/malformed data; contradictory duplicate complete scopes refuse. Numeric source quantities are supplied nonnegative finite binary64 decimal strings, integer increments are exact u64. Arithmetic overflow/positive parse or mean underflow is unavailable, never known zero; original pandas/NumPy dependency versions/serialization/bit parity are not recovered.

Source-only bounded component and standalone derived CSV/receipt/export, not kernel input or full-profile execution. ClearAll filter_active/Python JSON truth, cardinality/set accumulation, category occurrence count, integer denominator sum, count ratios, finite extrema, ordered scalar sum and existing median/group mean are shared owners, not new algorithms. Deterministic Chronicle ordering is engineering transport, not author pandas/HashSet/event serialization.

Borapp retained primary Table4: admitted unlock occurrence count and supplied received/transmitted byte increment sums within declared complete horizon. limitations: Only supplied complete saved-screen and phrase occurrence memberships are counted. Exactly one inventory manifest qualifies completeness; every phrase references a uniquely declared saved screen and coherent screen_order. A declared empty inventory computes saved-screen count0; a declared saved screen with no phrases computes per-screen density0.

The existing occurrence-count body counts every saved screen for information updates and every phrase occurrence per saved screen for information density. Repeated phrase text is not deduplicated; phrase occurrence IDs distinguish observations. No averaging across screens, word tokenization or symmetric-difference/unique-text churn is performed.

Source saving only changed content, Accessibility capture/coverage, UI-node parsing, raw source delimiter/serializer, screen identity/order construction, OCR, VADER, app/context joins and scientific counts remain upstream. This component emits both disclosed simple measures under the unchanged existing owner, not an invented mean-density statistic.

Lexical participant/entity/window/stream/units are retained without trimming, normalization or conversion. Only blank validation applies; conflicting scoped units and duplicate source identity/order fail closed. Groups retain first-seen order and arithmetic follows explicit numeric sample/lag ordering; there is no resampling, source unit parser or raw chronology reconstruction.

Missing/nonfinite or unqualified source inventories fail closed without removal/imputation. Existing ordered mean nonfinite arithmetic and detected division underflow emit per-result empty/arithmetic_unavailable while other supplied groups/statistics remain computable. Output-unit relations are explicit input_unit for scalar means/calibration, seconds_per_session, exact count relations or Boolean as appropriate; caller unit labels are not mislabeled as all output units.

Full parent remains blocked. Only these named prepared reductions and their exact source owners are bound, not unknown acquisition/window/schema/serializer/model policies, stressor/questionnaire scoring, GPS or whole-study replication.

Bounded calculation of symmetric difference and cardinality for one caller-resolved pair of sequential screens carrying exact Accessibility text-node phrase strings. The component does not choose a preceding screen, infer chronology or first-screen handling, collect Accessibility events, perform OCR, tokenize words, or parse the source's underspecified delimited snapshot.

Set membership uses exact supplied strings without trimming, case folding or Unicode normalization; within-screen duplicates are discarded. Both removed and added phrases are counted. The output array is lexically sorted only for deterministic serialization; this is not a claimed source phrase order.

Explicit empty phrase arrays are accepted; missing, null or non-string phrase inputs fail. Caller stage/identity declarations are not proof of original collector provenance. Context aggregation, app-category joins, questionnaires and downstream analyses remain outside; the full paper profile is blocked.

limitations: Accepted manuscript physical p10/article9 §3.2.1 lines503–514 defines per-session app total duration and no app-order use. This explicitly typed Android adaptation is not evidence that the historical35 collector or logs were Android: that OS is not named. The distinct Android Socialize20 branch is not substituted.

Input is caller-qualified session/app duration contributions with supplied lexical participant/device/session/app ownership, duration_unit, platform=android, branch_adaptation=historical_duration_bag_android_adaptation and duration_stage=caller-qualified-session-app-contribution. No session construction, raw foreground matching, overlap handling, app relabeling, clipping or duration derivation is inferred.

Existing grouped SUM receives finite nonnegative binary64 contributions with identity scaling/projection. Supported explicit ns/us/ms/s/min units are retained without conversion and may not mix within a supplied session. Binary64 input/order-of-addition and first-seen output presentation are Chronicle engineering choices, not recovered author precision, serialization or app-order features; repeated source IDs contribute every supplied row.

Only one app-duration total per supplied owner/app remains in the bag. Empty input yields a valid header-only result; missing/nonfinite/negative inputs and nonfinite totals fail closed because these source policies are undisclosed, not zero filled or assigned R missing-value semantics.

historical.boa_tfidf remains unimplemented: no exact term-frequency, IDF corpus/normalization, DBSCAN, context joins, association rules, models or study reproduction is claimed. Source-read hand math is not author-code execution; full-profile execution remains blocked.

limitations: Physical primary PDF p3 Navigation Time defines navigation-type opening to app start, measured in seconds. Input starts at caller-resolved corresponding anchors, not raw launcher/logcat events, unlock latency, an app-use session or last touch.

Seventeen required Chronicle carrier fields preserve supplied source-row, participant, device, navigation and endpoint identities, exact endpoint roles and declared clocks. Start/end participant/device/navigation owners must agree, endpoint IDs must differ, and anchor_pairing_stage must be caller-resolved; no one-to-one matcher, origin classifier or raw event linkage is inferred.

Signed i64 coordinates are explicitly time_unit=ns transport values supplied on a declared clock, not claimed original author timestamp encoding, resolution, epoch or timezone. Existing widened i128 subtraction computes end minus start before an exact decimal seconds projection. Original lexical columns/row order and repeated occurrences remain unchanged.

Negative and zero differences are retained as supplied-order arithmetic, not silently clamped or validated as source-admitted navigation trials. Empty timestamp/clock fields or incompatible endpoint clocks preserve the row with an explicit unavailable timing result; malformed nonempty timestamps, wrong ownership/roles/units and supplied computed-output columns fail closed.

Original raw pairing, ties, repeated openings, abandonment, interruptions, trial exclusions and censoring remain undisclosed. No origin classifier, participant average, ANOVA, questionnaire join or deployed-study result is promoted; full-profile execution remains blocked. The CSV is Chronicle's carrier/export, not the author serializer, and hand fixtures do not execute author code.

limitations: Retained MoMM2014 author manuscript pp2–3§3.3 renders screen diagonal7inches: >=7 tablet, <7 smartphone; equality is tablet. Caller supplies source-qualified finite diagonal with explicit inch unit. Existing finite scalar pivot classifier reuses exact equality, without tolerance or GSM-capability substitution.

Only supplied diagonal classification executes. Resolution/pixel-density conversion/encoding, raw collection, original numeric precision, device taxonomy, context and full source method are not constructed. Raw device/observation/scalar/unit tokens survive; missing/nonfinite/wrong-unit/unknown qualification and duplicate output owner refuse. Broad67667 diagonal-construction atom remains unbound.

Retained MoMM2014 author manuscript p5§5/text267–277 separately computes per-device means across ALL observed days, means of session durations across the ENTIRE observation period, then grand mean=mean of device means. These NEW narrow mean-only owners require complete caller-qualified memberships for exactly one declared feature/usage/context/form-factor stratum. owner_id identifies the device for per-device stages and caller-resolved population for grand mean; observations' sample_id identifies day/session/device according to the stage.

Each supplied finite observation and literal member identity is preserved. Exactly one summary per supplied device is allowed in a grand-mean row through distinct device IDs; every device receives equal weight, never session counts or pooled observations. Grouped complete mean is reused. day, session and device membership completeness is caller qualification, not inferred calendar/collector evidence; stage/feature/qualification mismatches and duplicate output/member identities refuse.

daily_mean permits daily_interaction_count or daily_usage_time; session_mean permits session_duration; device_grand_mean permits one supplied mean per device for those same features. No upstream day construction, zero-day inclusion, timezone/day boundary, crossing-session splitting, session constructor, overall composition, rescaling or context join is invented. Empty membership and nonfinite arithmetic yield unavailable, not source missingness imputation.

Median/quartile/grand-median/median-of-device-means and source cohort/result claims are excluded; broad43ed/71cd/b2a3 remain unbound. Supplied stratum tokens remain literal; known usage and form-factor vocabularies are validated without merging padded context/owner IDs. Existing R-style mean correction is not author floating-point parity.

Retained MoMM2014 rendered author.pdf p3Figure1/footnote supplies six literal states and13 supported edge groups/actions. Caller supplies explicit initial state and ordered identified source event keys, plus source-qualified locked_length_equals_authentication_time boolean only where keyguard removal branches. One minimal source-specific loop emits each supported from/to/action trace in original event order, including discard locked session only for supplied equality; otherwise end locked session.

The thirteen source edge/action groups, call-related screen self-loops, ringing/offhook/idle paths, shutdown endings and authentication actions are retained verbatim. Existing PIN-retry keyguard FSM and HardLock/idle/capture methods are different sources and are not aliased. No generic FSM framework, event sorting, raw state/clock inference, session-ID serializer, numeric equality precision, minimum/inactivity rule or raw interval construction is added.

Unknown initial state, unsupported transition or unknown equality makes that complete row unavailable with an exact reason; unrelated valid traces still execute. No partial prefix is mislabeled complete. Missing/duplicate/blank event IDs, malformed typed membership, supplied equality on another supported edge and unknown qualification refuse. A supported trace ending in an active state is retained as a prefix with no inferred terminal close/restart/censoring action.

Raw CSV/JSON/participant/device/stream/trace/event tokens and supplied order survive. Completeness/edge eligibility/order/equality truth is caller qualification, not source chronological verification. Broad6e5 raw constructor,c089 numeric equality realization and359 terminal marks remain unbound. Output is a supported state/action trace, NOT original session rows, full method reproduction, public admission or author-code execution.

limitations: Rodrigues primary physicalp7§4.3,physicalp9Table1. Caller-qualified complete trial/session hold/flight pair inventories give same-key press-to-release hold and release-to-next-keypress flight. Both named arithmetic means execute and project declared ns/us/ms/s coordinates explicitly to reported milliseconds. Exact i128 pair differences remain visible separately. Empty/missing named domain mean is unavailable. Negative closed hold contradicts qualification; signed flight overlap is preserved without invented cap/filter. Raw key pairing/session/word boundaries, touch offsets, source raw-clock scale and historical averaging missingness remain unknown. Retained complementary known endpoints validate coherent clocks and closed-hold chronology without filling any row input. Pair identity uses structural (kind,start-event,end-event) tuples, preserving literal slash-containing IDs and identical repeats; signed flight remains permitted.

Original lexical CSV cells/JSON, source row IDs, explicit device/stream/participant/scope, list order and extra columns survive one-to-one. Duplicate recognized JSON keys are refused by ordinary typed serde fields before collapse; distinct complete-inventory IDs and zero-based source order where specified are caller qualifications. Local known identity facts are checked across repeated declarations without imputing any row's missing calculation input. A device in one input requires stable participant/source stream and declared coordinate unit/positive precision metadata; precision is not quantization, rounding or epoch-modulo alignment. Explicit[] is complete empty; empty inventory cell/unknown scalar remains unavailable. Known coherent clock/endpoints use unchanged i64-to-i128 elapsed helper; binary64 ordered sum/projection/mean/count ratio is Chronicle's disclosed typed numeric boundary, not historical runtime parity. Full source profile, raw constructors, cohorts, models and app/WASM proof remain unclaimed.
